name: Features Extraction
description: Extract geometric features from point clouds: normals, curvature, and FPFH descriptors for registration and analysis.

videos.title: Signals, 3D Point Clouds & Images: Features Analysis

theory.overview:
Geometric feature extraction computes descriptors that characterize the local or global shape of a point cloud.

Normal estimation fits a local tangent plane to neighbors. Curvature is estimated from eigenvalues of the local covariance matrix. FPFH descriptors encode angular relationships between normals.

normal_estimation.title: Normal Estimation
normal_estimation.content: The normal $\vec{n}_i$ is the eigenvector corresponding to the smallest eigenvalue of $\mathbf{C}_i$. Normals are oriented consistently using tangent plane propagation.

fpfh_features.title: FPFH Features
fpfh_features.content: Fast Point Feature Histograms encode angular relationships between normals into a 33-dimensional descriptor using three angular features $(\alpha, \phi, \theta)$.

curvature_estimation.title: Curvature Estimation
curvature_estimation.content: Curvature $\kappa_i = \frac{\lambda_0}{\lambda_0 + \lambda_1 + \lambda_2}$. Near 0 = flat, near $1/3$ = high curvature.

parameters.name: fast_normal_computation
parameters.description: Use the faster (less accurate) covariance eigen solver in estimate_normals.

parameters.name: orient_k
parameters.description: k neighbors for consistent tangent-plane orientation (0 = auto min(max_nn,15)).

parameters.name: voxel_size
parameters.description: Voxel size for downsampling before feature computation.

parameters.name: normal_radius_factor
parameters.description: Normal search radius as a multiple of voxel_size.

parameters.name: normal_max_nn
parameters.description: Maximum nearest neighbors for normal estimation.

parameters.name: feature_radius_factor
parameters.description: FPFH search radius as a multiple of voxel_size.

parameters.name: feature_max_nn
parameters.description: Maximum nearest neighbors for FPFH feature computation.

parameters.name: normalize_percentile
parameters.description: Percentile of curvature used as the color-normalization ceiling.
